title: Fluid namespaces and folder-by-filter projections
summary: A path is a contextual view over StorageRef, not a permanent claim about where bytes live. The same object can be projected through multiple logical paths and query-derived folders, each with independent route semantics.
invariants: PATH, OBJECT, LOCATION and POLICY are never conflated.
Logical directories may be explicit bindings, query folders, aliases or composed union/search paths.
Removing a generated/query entry is an unlink/exclusion operation, not implicit destruction of every replica.
Namespace semantics remain logical in v0.1; no OS/FUSE mounted-filesystem claim is made.

provenance.claim: Regression proves query-folder projection, EA predicates and safe exclusion without object destruction.
